playstyle.identity: Vel'Koz is an artillery mage who researches enemies to deal true damage. His abilities combo together to stack his passive for bonus damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: 3 ability hits = true damage proc. Q fires a bolt that can split at angles. W creates a line that erupts. E knocks up in an area. R channels a massive laser that constantly stacks and procs passive. Hit abilities to stack passive, then R for massive damage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vel'Koz spikes at level 6 with his laser ultimate. Luden's scales his poke. He's strong at poking and teamfighting.

passive.name: Organic Deconstruction
passive.summary: After 3 ability hits, deal true damage.
passive.details: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Deconstruction stacks. At 3 stacks, the enemy takes bonus true damage.

abilities.name: Plasma Fission
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt that can split at 90 degree angles.
abilities.details: Vel'Koz fires a bolt that slows. It can split into two bolts at 90-degree angles on recast or at max range.

abilities.name: Void Rift
abilities.summary: Create a rift that erupts for damage.
abilities.details: Vel'Koz opens a rift that deals damage immediately and again after a delay when it erupts.

abilities.name: Tectonic Disruption
abilities.summary: Disrupt the ground, knocking up enemies.
abilities.details: Vel'Koz disrupts a patch of ground, knocking up and damaging enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Lifeform Disintegration Ray
abilities.summary: Channel a laser that deals damage and stacks passive.
abilities.details: Vel'Koz channels a beam of energy, dealing damage per second and slowing enemies. Each tick applies and procs his passive, dealing true damage.
